blocks.html:
Firefly Bar is tucked inside the Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel near Langsuan and Ploenchit, and it earned a spot on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 at No.82 on the extended 51-100 list. The room is dressed in forest green, inky black and gold, with high ceilings, polished dark wood, warm low lighting and live jazz every night. It genuinely makes you forget the chaos of Bangkok from the first step inside. If you want a cocktail spot with a story to tell, elegant but never stuffy, this is one of the most rewarding rooms in the neighbourhood.

The current menu, In Pursuit of the Firefly, tells the story of the firefly across four chapters: Etymology, Ecosystem, Luminescence and Mythology. Each glass leans on Thai and regional ingredients handled with real craft. Blue Moon blends Michter's American Whiskey and Rye redistilled with Sri Sindhorn tea, peach, blue spirulina and Lustau Amontillado for a smooth, gently fruity pour. Journey to Amphawa nods to the riverside town famous for its night-time firefly displays, built on Phraya Rum 8 Years with soft aromatics, while Where Is The Cricket captures the firefly's three body parts working as one. The bartenders build creative drinks from local produce, and the service is attentive without being formal.

Getting there is easy: take the BTS to Ploenchit or Chidlom, then a short ride or walk into Soi Ton Son to the Sindhorn Kempinski. The bar runs 5pm to 1am and suits a date night or a small group catch-up. Booking ahead helps, especially on Friday and Saturday when the jazz is in full swing. Cocktails sit at premium five-star hotel prices, and the dress code is smart casual, so a collared shirt and tidy shoes will see you right through.

faq.q: How do I get to Firefly Bar and which BTS station is closest?
faq.a: Take the BTS to Ploenchit or Chidlom, then a short ride or walk into Soi Ton Son. The bar sits inside Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok in the Langsuan area of Lumphini, Pathum Wan.

faq.q: Do I need to book ahead?
faq.a: Booking is recommended, especially on Friday and Saturday when the live jazz is in full swing, so you get a good table without waiting. Walk-ins are possible but the room can fill up.
Cocktails sit at premium five-star hotel prices, so budget accordingly if you plan to order several rounds with a few bites.
Yes, smart casual. A collared shirt and tidy shoes are fine. The bar is open from 5pm to 1am.
